events.description: Acquisition of 100 percent of the shares of Aquasana, Inc. (Aquasana), a Texas-based water treatment company, for an aggregate cash purchase price of $84.8 million, net of $1.9 million of cash acquired, plus $1.2 million of acquisition-related costs.
events.source_quote: On August 8, 2016, the Company acquired 100 percent of the shares of Aquasana, Inc. (Aquasana), a Texas-based water treatment company. ... The Company paid an aggregate cash purchase price of $84.8 million, net of $1.9 million of cash acquired. In addition, the Company incurred acquisition-related costs of approximately $1.2 million.
events.section: Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements

events.description: Declaration of a two-for-one stock split of the Company’s Class A Common Stock and Common Stock (including treasury shares) in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend, payable on October 5, 2016, to stockholders of record on September 21, 2016.
events.source_quote: on September 7, 2016, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a two-for-one stock split of the Company’s Class A Common Stock and Common Stock (including treasury shares) in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend to stockholders of record on September 21, 2016 and payable on October 5, 2016.
events.section: Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements

events.description: Declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share on Common Stock and Class A common stock, payable on November 15, 2016, to shareholders of record on October 31, 2016.
events.source_quote: On October 6, 2016, our Board of Directors declared a regular cash dividend of $0.12 per share on our Common Stock and Class A common stock. The dividend is payable on November 15, 2016 to shareholders of record on October 31, 2016.

events.description: Repurchase of 382,558 shares of Common Stock in the third quarter of 2016 under the Company's discretionary share repurchase program at an average price of $47.01 per share, for a total cost of $18.0 million.
events.source_quote: In the third quarter of 2016, we repurchased 382,558 shares at an average price of $47.01 per share and at a total cost of $18.0 million.
